summary: Iteration 8: tested the redesigned Jeweller panel, Master panel, v3 APIs and customer Expo app (no-sell changes). New pytest suite test_panel_redesign_v3.py has 36 tests and all 36 pass. That covers: dashboard ranges 1d/3d/7d/30d/custom and bad-date 400; commission save reflecting in /api/price (buy = base_rate + commission), validation (gold <= 1000, silver <= 100, no negatives), reset to 0/0; orders buy/redeem only, metal/side/search filters, bill, tenant isolation (Patel cannot read a Sharma bill or holding, gets 404); holdings list and detail; settings; min redemption; gifts/referral/kyc/pickups/products/customers pages; master overview and all endpoints; jeweller token blocked on master; POST /api/sell returns 403; customer buy works. UI checks at 1920 desktop: Jeweller panel login, all 11 tabs render with no JS page errors, dashboard KPIs (#kpi-active/#kpi-inactive/#kpi-gold-booked) change with every range incl. Custom (#r_from + Apply), commission calc updates while typing (75 gives 7292.54 -> 7367.54), save reaches the customer price, 1500 is rejected, reset done. Orders side filter shows only All/Buy/Redeem; View bill modal (opaque white) shows shop, customer, item, metal, grams, rate, amount, charges, GST, total. Wallet & Holdings drawer shows holdings, purchased, redeemed, pickups and activity. Settings app key reveal works and min redemption saves. Redemptions: counter redeem (0.1g Aarav) works; pickup handover rejects a wrong OTP and accepts the right one (Rohan, Patel). KYC approve works. Catalogue add product works; remove product had a bug (fixed, see below). Master panel: overview ranges incl. custom, Jewellers table, onboard modal (opaque), Domains modal, suspend then re-activate Patel (left Active), Live Rates shows 'Indicative/Not connected' (expected), pool threshold saves, Invoices empty state, Transactions store/type filters (no sell type), Customers. Customer app at 390x844: tabs are Home/Vault/Jewellery/SIP; no Wallet tab (/wallet gives Unmatched Route); Vault has no Sell action or filter; buy via UI (Rs 50) works end to end. I fixed 2 bugs: catalogue removed products still listed in the panel, and the Vault 'Gifts' passbook filter always being empty.

minor.issue: FIXED by testing agent: returned soft-deleted (is_active=False) products, so the panel showed the 'Removed' toast but the product stayed in the Catalogue grid.

FIXED by testing agent: filtered Transaction.type == 'gift', but stored types are gift_sent/gift_received, so the customer app Vault 'Gifts' passbook filter was always empty. It now maps 'gift' to [gift_sent, gift_received].
customers.active counts any transaction in range, including failed payments. Should filter status != failed and buy/redeem types only.
invested/purchased totals sum all buy-type txns without excluding status 'failed'.

422 errors surface raw pydantic text in the UI toast ('Input should be less than or equal to 1000', 'String should have at least 2 characters' x4 with no field names). Add client-side validation or friendly messages.
Create response omits 'occasion' (GET list includes it). Inconsistent response shape.

Patel customers (Rohan 3.77g, Ananya 3.49g) hold gold with 0 purchase transactions, so Holdings shows Invested Rs 0 and Purchased 0g but an avg buy price of Rs 5,562/g. Seed should create matching buy txns.

ui_bugs.component: Customer app FAQ / Referral share text
ui_bugs.issue: Still promotes selling: faq.tsx:14 'Can I sell my gold anytime? Yes...', faq.tsx:17 mentions selling, referral.tsx:48 'Buy, sell & save'. This contradicts the no-sell requirement.
Silver card shows '24K | 999'. Karat does not apply to silver; should be '999 Fine'. src/components/PriceCards.tsx:41
KPI labels 'Gold sold' / 'Silver sold' (jeweller_admin.html:206-207) conflict with the no-sell wording. Use 'Gold booked' / 'Silver booked' as on the Dashboard.

issues: Orders toolbar: search input is squeezed beside the selects and its placeholder is truncated; selects wrap unevenly
Content max-width (~1030px) leaves ~300px of empty space on the right while the top rate chip is right-aligned to the viewport, so the header and content edges do not line up
Product cards show blank placeholder tiles (image_url is empty for seeded products). Reuse the app's category images so the panel matches the customer app
A back arrow is shown on a root tab screen; bottom tab labels sit very close to the bottom edge at 844px

action_items: Remove the sell references from the customer app FAQ (faq.tsx:14,17) and the referral share message (referral.tsx:48)
Rename the 'Gold sold'/'Silver sold' KPIs on the Orders page to 'booked'
Exclude failed txns from dashboard active-customer count and from holdings invested/purchased sums
Add friendly client-side validation for commission limits and the onboard form instead of raw pydantic messages
Fix the silver '24K | 999' label in PriceCards
Fix mobile overflow on the jeweller dashboard and the orders toolbar layout at <=390px
Seed Patel customers with buy transactions matching their balances

Clean up stale legacy tests: test_vaultra_api.py (old /api/admin PIN API, /tenants, sell flow), test_gifts_alerts.py (tenant 'vaultra', alert target 500 now valid), test_goals.py (expects 'occasion' in the POST response)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2415 lines and should be split into routers (public/customer/jeweller/master/v3)
server.py:977-990: the old sell() function body is left as dead code (no decorator) below sell_disabled; remove it
/api/price payloads still expose 'sell' rates (unused). Consider dropping them so no client re-adds sell
_range_bounds silently falls back to 1d for unknown range keys; consider a 400
/api/tenant/resolve returns 404 on the preview host. That is expected, but it logs a console error on every panel load

success_rate.backend: 100% (36/36 new v3 tests; legacy suite failures are stale tests, apart from the gift filter bug now fixed)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows work; catalogue remove bug fixed; minor copy and design issues)

Commission reset to 0/0; Sharma min redemption restored to 1g; Patel re-activated; pool threshold unchanged (10g). The regression suite added TEST customers/buys to Sharma (orders now ~42).
